Hi Samir / Alex —

Great to meet this morning. Quick recap from our discovery and agreed next steps so we have alignment on stakeholders and timelines:

- Economic buyer: Samir Patel, VP of Data & Analytics (you)
- Security reviewer: Nina Torres, Sr. InfoSec Manager (will own SOC/pen-test review)
- Ops/procurement: Alex Gomez, Head of Ops (procurement and contract)

Decision criteria you called out:
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 Type II + recent pen test summary
- Data handling: clear retention and audit log guarantees
- Latency/throughput: support for inference bursts (we'll provide perf numbers for your payload)
- Cost & rollout model: hosted API vs dedicated capacity options

Open items / next steps:
1) We (Redwood) to send SOC 2 evidence and summary of recent pen test by end of week (Ben / Dev).
2) Dev to share a sample audit log export and data retention policy docs.
3) Samir/Alex to confirm procurement timeline and any SSO/KMS requirements (if relevant).
4) Schedule a 30-min technical follow-up next week with Dev and your infra/data folks — Alex, please suggest times.

If that matches your notes, we'll get the documents over and set up the follow-up.

Thanks —
Ben Carter | Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Thanks Ben — that matches. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- Nina (copied) will be our security reviewer. She needs SOC 2 Type II (full report or executive summary + auditor letter) and a recent pen test executive summary. If you have a redacted full report we can sign an NDA, otherwise a summary will suffice for initial review.
- Procurement (Alex) will need a draft SOW and standard pricing sheet. We may request a short statement of expected monthly tokens/requests for pricing accuracy.
- On data handling: we need confirmation of retention window options (90/365 days) and whether we can opt for customer-managed keys.

Can you send the items below?
1) SOC2 Type II exec summary or redacted report
2) Pen test exec summary
3) Audit logs sample + explanation of what fields are included
4) Data retention & deletion policy (how to request deletion, SLA)

If you can get those to us by EOD Friday that keeps us on schedule. I'll coordinate internal procurement timing once we have the docs.

Appreciate it —
Samir

Hi Samir —

Following up with the evidence we discussed. See attached stubs and links below. Happy to share redacted/NDAd full reports if needed — we can route through legal.

Attachments included (redacted PDFs, summary versions):
- SOC2-type2-report-2025.pdf (redacted exec summary + auditor letter)
- pen-test-summary.pdf (executive summary, last test Dec 2025)
- audit-logs-sample.csv (anonymized sample of fields exported)

Quick notes:
- Data retention: default retention is 90 days for request/response logs; we offer 365-day retention for Dedicated or Enterprise plans. Full deletion can be requested via support ticket; standard SLA is 72 hours for deletion from active storage plus longer-term archival policies described in the linked doc.
- Audit logs: sample shows timestamp, request_id, model_id, token_count, masked_user_input (PII redacted), response_token_count, region, and request_latency_ms. We can export logs to your S3 (presigned) or push to your SIEM via webhook.
- KMS: we support customer-managed keys via our KMS integration on Dedicated/Private deployments. For hosted API we use Redwood-managed keys unless contractually requested.

Links: 
- SOC2 & security overview: https://redwood.com/security/soc2-2025
- Data retention & deletion policy: https://app.redwood.com/policies/data-retention
- Audit log export doc: https://redwood.sharepoint.com/:u:/s/QNTX-eval/ESharedDocId123

Next steps I suggest:
- Ben / Alex to coordinate a 30-min technical sync next week (we're available Tue/Wed afternoons PT).
- If procurement needs an SOW/pricing, Marissa will follow up with a draft.

Let me know if you need the full unredacted SOC2/pen-test under NDA.

Thanks,
Dev Patel | Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
